retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast hypnotic spiral background paired with textured, hand-lettered script and a structured black header bar.

recipe.visualDefinition: A square composition featuring a central blue and black hypnotic spiral that radiates from the middle. A thick black header bar sits at the top containing wide, slab-serif typography. The central focal point is a large, hand-drawn script with a yellow halftone texture and a heavy black drop shadow.
coreVisualRelationships: The spiral lines converge directly behind the central script logo.
The yellow script provides a warm contrast to the cool blue spiral.
The black header bar anchors the top, providing a stable frame for the movement below.
Halftone patterns within the lettering create a tactile, printed feel.
coreInvariants: Heavy black drop shadows on central text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large central script logo scaled to 70% of the width, positioned slightly above the vertical center.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central point of the spiral and the large 'B' and 'R' of the script.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye is drawn into the center by the spiral, then moves horizontally across the main script, and finally upward to the header text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the spiral fills the entire lower 85% of the frame.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep blue and black in the spiral pattern.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Golden yellow for the main script lettering.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Silver or light grey for the central ampersand/symbol.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation blue against deep black; high value yellow against the dark background.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to 4-5 colors: Blue, Black, Yellow, Silver, White.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Western-influenced brush script and wide slab-serif.
letterConstructionRules: Main script features thick, expressive strokes with sharp terminals.
Halftone dot pattern fill within the yellow letters.
Header text uses an ultra-wide, extended slab-serif with heavy horizontal emphasis.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The ampersand is stylized as a vertical, intertwined symbol with a different texture.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Expressive, textured script for the brand name paired with a rigid, extended slab-serif for the subtitle.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the expressive, hand-drawn feel of the main logo.
Matches the wide, blocky header text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a square image with a hypnotic spiral pattern of alternating blue and black lines radiating from the center. Add a solid black horizontal bar across the top 15% of the image. Apply a subtle vintage paper texture and slight distressing to the edges.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place a large, hand-lettered brush script logo in the center with a yellow halftone dot fill and a heavy black drop shadow. In the top black bar, typeset secondary text in an ultra-wide, all-caps slab-serif font in white.

verificationChecks: Is the spiral centered behind the main text?
Does the main text have a halftone texture?
Is the color palette limited to blue, black, yellow, and white?

postGenerationChecks: Verify the spiral does not cause visual vibrating artifacts that obscure text.
Ensure the halftone pattern is visible at 100% zoom.
Check that the header text is perfectly centered in the black bar.
Confirm the drop shadow on the script is solid black.
recipe.reuseFormula: Spiral Background + Textured Script + Slab Header = Retro Psychedelic Country Aesthetic
